limitations: Host audit samples same-user process CPU/IO/RSS and all GPU compute PIDs every ~2 seconds, with whole-NVMe settling checks before each case; it cannot exclude every short OS event. Stage event intervals are accumulated GPU stream time, may include stream stalls, and are not a pure kernel breakdown or a sum of end-to-end request wall time. Four fixed fresh starts (three default, one LIGHT_CHECK diagnostic) are a bounded verification sample, not an unbiased frequency estimate or a clean speed/quality comparison. Output IDs can differ.
